audience: developers and sysadmins who run servers, volumes and networks on Hetzner Cloud

useCases.title: Check which servers run and what they cost
useCases.text: The AI lists servers with their status and type, then reads the price list and server types. You get a monthly cost view per server.

useCases.title: Look at CPU, disk or network use of a server
useCases.text: The AI reads CPU, disk or network time series for one server over a time window. You can spot load peaks or an idle machine.

useCases.title: Review firewalls, networks and load balancers
useCases.text: The AI lists firewalls with their rules and applied resources, private networks with subnets and routes, and load balancers with targets and health. You see how your setup connects.

useCases.title: Check volumes, floating IPs and TLS certificate expiry
useCases.text: The AI lists volumes with their size and attached server, floating IPs with their server, and certificates with their expiry. It helps you find unused or expiring items.

useCases.title: Snapshot a server or change its backups
useCases.text: The AI creates a snapshot image of a server's disk, and turns automatic backups on or off. Snapshots and backups add cost, and turning backups off deletes existing backups.

useCases.title: Change a server's power state or protection
useCases.text: The AI powers on a stopped server, reboots it, or shuts it down gracefully, and can turn deletion and rebuild protection on or off. Each action returns an action id to check. A stopped server still costs money.
